description: Canonical dashboard for the future Django 'Resources' page: device/system health -- CPU, memory, telemetry freshness, device uptime, and collector CPU-threshold alerts. Sources: gnmi_telemetry (continuous per-device state/metrics), snmp_poll (uptime/cross-check CPU), collector_alert (event-optional), syslog_event (event-optional). See docs/GRAFANA_MONITORING_TAXONOMY.md.

panels.description: Count of devices with a real hostname telemetry sample in the last five minutes. Missing data is not treated as UP.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -5m)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "system_identity" and r._field == "hostname")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
          |> group()
          |> unique(column: "device")
          |> count(column: "device")
          |> rename(columns: {device: "_value"})

panels.title: Devices reporting (5m)

panels.description: Age of the stalest last-received identity sample. Green <60s, amber 60-120s, red >120s.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -30d)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "system_identity" and r._field == "hostname")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device"])
          |> last()
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
          |> group()
          |> max()

panels.title: Worst telemetry age

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "system_cpu" and r._field == "cpu_total_pct")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device"])
          |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
          |> last()

panels.description: Count of collector-generated CPU threshold ALERT transitions in the selected range (measurement collector_alert, source=collector) -- distinct from device-originated SNMP traps. Legitimately zero when no device has crossed the configured threshold.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "collector_alert" and r.alert_type == "cpu_threshold" and r.transition == "alert")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
          |> group()
          |> count()

panels.title: NMAS Collector CPU Alerts (range)

panels.description: Health is based only on observed telemetry age; absent devices are never fabricated as healthy. 'Unhealthy only' hides HEALTHY rows -- this can legitimately empty the table when the whole fleet is healthy.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -30d)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "system_identity" and r._field == "hostname")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform"])
          |> last()
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with age_seconds: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, status: if int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time) < 60000000000 then "HEALTHY" else if int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time) < 120000000000 then "STALE" else "OFFLINE"}))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => ("${unhealthy_only}" == "false") or r.status != "HEALTHY")
          |> keep(columns: ["device", "platform", "_time", "age_seconds", "status"])
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["device"])

panels.title: Per-device health & freshness

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "system_cpu" and r._field == "cpu_total_pct")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device"])
          |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "system_memory" and (r._field == "mem_used_bytes" or r._field == "mem_physical_bytes"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
          |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "device", "platform"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.mem_physical_bytes and exists r.mem_used_bytes and r.mem_physical_bytes > 0)
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 100.0 * float(v: r.mem_used_bytes) / float(v: r.mem_physical_bytes)}))
          |> group(columns: ["device"])
          |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.description: Device uptime and last SNMP poll age (HOST-RESOURCES-MIB sysUpTime) -- the only stored source of device uptime; gNMI does not stream an uptime leaf in the current schema.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -30d)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp_poll" and r.metric == "sysUpTime" and r._field == "value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "management_ip"])
          |> last()
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with uptime_seconds: float(v: r._value) / 100.0, poll_age_seconds: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
          |> keep(columns: ["device", "platform", "management_ip", "_time", "poll_age_seconds", "uptime_seconds"])
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["device"])

panels.title: SNMP-polled CPU & device uptime

panels.description: Critical-or-worse syslog for the selected device/severity. syslog_event has no topic tag separating resource from interface/link messages, so this is the full matching feed, not a topic-specific subset -- a disclosed limitation, not a fabricated split.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
      |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog_event" and r._field == "message")
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with device: if r.device == "mgmt-swt" then "mgmt_swt" else r.device, platform: if exists r.platform then r.platform else "unknown"}))
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.severity =~ /^${severity:regex}$/)
      |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "platform", "source_ip", "severity", "facility", "_value"])
      |> rename(columns: {_value: "message"})
      |> group()
      |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
      |> limit(n: 200)
